config.markdown:
### Logs
A three-stage log experience: **1. Log Overview** for health and volume, **2. Log Search & Exploration** for investigation, and **3. Live Log Streaming** for real-time monitoring. The dashboard filter bar provides Resource, Cluster, Host, Namespace, Pod, Application / Service, and Severity filters; the global time picker provides Timestamp filtering.

## 1. Log Overview
High-level understanding of log health and volume across the selected time range.

tiles.name: Total logs (selected range)
Average logs / sec

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT count() / greatest(({endDateMilliseconds:Int64} - {startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) / 1000, 1) AS "Logs / sec" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

tiles.name: Error + fatal logs (selected range)
Log error rate %
Fatal log count

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT countIf(SeverityNumber >= 21 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'fatal') AS "Fatal logs" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

tiles.name: Average error + fatal logs / sec

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) / greatest(({endDateMilliseconds:Int64} - {startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) / 1000, 1) AS "Errors / sec" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

tiles.name: Log volume by severity
Error & fatal log count over time, by service
Log volume trends

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond(greatest(toInt64(1), intDiv({endDateMilliseconds:Int64} - {startDateMilliseconds:Int64}, toInt64(120000))))) AS ts,
            count() AS Logs
     FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
     WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND $__filters
     GROUP BY ts
     ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Log count per time bucket by severity

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond(greatest(toInt64(1), intDiv({endDateMilliseconds:Int64} - {startDateMilliseconds:Int64}, toInt64(120000))))) AS ts,
            SeverityText AS Severity, count() AS Logs
     FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
     WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND $__filters
     GROUP BY ts, Severity
     ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Error + fatal share of logs

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS "Error share" FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND $__filters

tiles.name: Services generating the most error and fatal logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS Service,
       countIf((SeverityNumber >= 17 AND SeverityNumber < 21) OR lower(SeverityText) = 'error') AS Errors,
       countIf(SeverityNumber >= 21 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'fatal') AS Fatals,
       countIf(SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) AS Total,
       maxIf(Timestamp, SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) AS "Last error"
FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY ServiceName
HAVING Total > 0
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 50

config.markdown:
## 2. Log Search & Exploration
Primary workspace for full-text investigation. Enter text or structured expressions in HyperDX search; combine the dashboard filters with the global time picker. Native HyperDX supplies the Log Query Builder, Saved Searches, Bookmarks & Favorites, Export Results, and log correlation actions.

tiles.name: Full-text log search - click a row for full details

config.select: Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'], ResourceAttributes['host.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], Body

tiles.name: Top error signatures (normalized) - click a row to open Logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service", pattern AS "Signature", count() AS "Count" FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName,
         replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(Body, '[0-9a-fA-F-]{8,}', '<id>'), '[0-9]+', '<n>') AS pattern
  FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
  WHERE (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))
    AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    AND $__filters
)
GROUP BY ServiceName, pattern
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.name: New error patterns in the past 24h

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ServiceName AS Service, signature AS "New signature", count() AS Occurrences, min(Timestamp) AS "First seen", max(Timestamp) AS "Last seen" FROM (SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(Body, '[0-9a-fA-F-]{8,}', '<id>'), '[0-9]+', '<n>') AS signature FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}} WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY AND (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal')) AND $__filters) GROUP BY ServiceName, signature HAVING "First seen" >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR ORDER BY Occurrences DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.name: Errors & fatals by service (last 24h) - click a row to open Logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       countIf(SeverityNumber = 17 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'error') AS "Errors",
       countIf(SeverityNumber = 21 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'fatal') AS "Fatal",
       max(Timestamp) AS "Last seen"
FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
WHERE (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal'))
  AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND $__filters
GROUP BY ServiceName
ORDER BY "Errors" + "Fatal" DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Top Kubernetes error sources (namespace / pod) - click a row to open Logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS "Namespace", ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod", ServiceName AS "Service", count() AS "Errors"
FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
WHERE (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))
  AND Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND $__filters
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod", ServiceName
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 50

onClick.whereTemplate: ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '{{Namespace}}' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] = '{{Pod}}' AND ServiceName = '{{Service}}' AND (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal'))

tiles.name: 100 most recent error and fatal logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText AS Severity, ServiceName AS Service,
       ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS Resource,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] AS Cluster,
       ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS Host,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS Namespace,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS Pod,
       substring(Body, 1, 500) AS Message
FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  AND (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error','fatal'))
  AND $__filters
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

config.markdown:
## 2.1. Investigation Tools & Correlation
Use the native HyperDX query builder above the search results to create full-text or structured queries. Save reusable queries, bookmark/favorite investigations, export result sets, and open correlated traces. Alert and metric context is available through the **Supportability**, **Overview**, **Traces**, and **Infrastructure** dashboards. For true live tail and Pause & Resume, open any stream row in the native Logs search workspace.

## 3. Live Log Streaming
Recent logs automatically refresh with the dashboard. Click a row to open the native HyperDX search workspace for true live-tail monitoring, Pause & Resume, full log details, and continued filtering by service, namespace, or pod.

tiles.name: Live log stream (dashboard refresh)

config.select: Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'], ResourceAttributes['host.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], Body

tiles.name: Live error stream (dashboard refresh) - click a row for full detail

config.select: Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'], ResourceAttributes['host.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], Body

tiles.name: Stream by service - click a row to open logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName AS Service, SeverityText AS Severity,
            substring(Body, 1, 240) AS Message
     FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
     WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND $__filters
     ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
     LIMIT 100

tiles.name: Stream by namespace / pod - click a row to open logs

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT Timestamp,
            ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS Namespace,
            ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS Pod,
            ServiceName AS Service, SeverityText AS Severity,
            substring(Body, 1, 200) AS Message
     FROM {{LOGS_SCHEMA}}.{{LOGS_TABLE}}
     WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
       AND $__filters
     ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
     LIMIT 100
